_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: The app now opens on a start menu: choose Log pallets or Manifest check. Each has its own page instead of one long page; tap ‹ Menu at the top, or press Back, to go back to the menu. With a delivery in progress, the menu shows how many pallets are logged and has a Carry on scanning button.
